_rule: <Name> — <what it is> for <when to use it>. Plain words, no jargon, <= 90 characters, no commas.
_why: The line IS the name, because asset.name is the only per-asset free text a motion graphic has and the only text at all an audio asset has. One definition; if a description field turns out to be read, the same bytes go there.
_separator_note: The twelve components and seven caption styles use an EM DASH. The thirteen sounds already shipped with a HYPHEN in their filenames. Both parse; changing the sounds means thirteen re-uploads. Flagged for Zac rather than normalised silently.

_density_note: Matched to ChatCut's own library descriptions, which name SEVERAL moments and not one ('for shock, reversals, exaggerated reactions, key captions, sudden pauses'). Theirs use commas; ours cannot, so the moments are joined with 'and'. A comma in a sound filename breaks the upload helper's ffmpeg filter graph and leaves an orphaned status:processing asset that never resolves.
_comma_rule: COMMAS ARE REFUSED IN THE THIRTEEN AUDIO NAMES ONLY, and permitted in the nineteen component and caption lines. The rule was never about style: a comma in a sound filename breaks the upload helper, which builds an ffmpeg filter graph from the name and takes a comma as the separator, and the failed import leaves an orphaned status:processing asset that counts and never resolves. Nothing about a component name goes near that path. Scoped to match B1's menu_name_ok — two checkers, one rule, and a leg that proves the scope rather than the wording.

_hard_constraints.StickyNotes: notes.slice(0, 3) — the fourth note is DROPPED, not shrunk
_hard_constraints._none: PlainText, CaptionMatch, StatCard, Reticle and Stamp carry no cap. Stamp only steps its font size down past 11 and 14 characters, which is graceful, not a limit — stating it as one would be inventing a constraint the body does not have.

_cut_presets.Prime: CUT 2026-09-23. Its whole identity is TWO LINES IN TWO COLOURS — white line 1 over #3BA5FF line 2 — and styleProfile has ONE `color` with no per-line key. Applied, it renders as a single white line, which is CleanCut with a different size. The line describing it would have been true of our Remotion component and false of everything ChatCut draws.
_cut_presets.Lumen: CUT 2026-09-23. Its keyword changes FACE (Playfair Display italic) and SIZE (1.3x, 1.6x on a shine word); styleProfile varies COLOUR per word and nothing else. What survives the mapping is white Montserrat with an amber spoken word — which is Gadzhi in a different hue, so it was a duplicate of a preset that maps cleanly rather than a style of its own.
_cut_presets._rule: A preset is kept only where the thing that MAKES it that preset survives into ChatCut's render. Both of these lost their identity in the mapping and would have shipped a true-sounding line describing a render nobody would ever see — the same defect as the three lines I had already written wrong this session, caught before shipping rather than after.

_catalogue_note: 22 catalogue components, not 16. The baked registry holds 28; six of the live twelve are in it (StickyNotes, StatCard, Stamp, PillCluster, RankedList, Reticle) and the other six are port/build frame compositions that were never in it. 28 - 6 = 22. Reported as measured rather than fitted to 16: a count I cannot reproduce is a count one of us is wrong about, and silently agreeing hides which. 2026-09-23: the five live-menu motion graphics (PillCluster, RankedList, Reticle, StatCard, StickyNotes) now carry lines too, so the catalogue is 27 — every registry component except Stamp, which is already in the live project. They were measured rather than described, which is why they had boxes and no words.
